column1: # Which component owns which staged runtime file on linux.
# Measured, not derived. The file names come from the combined runtime layout
# workflow, which builds the product against pinned Open CASCADE and pinned
# planegcs, walks the loader graph of both product binaries and stages what it
# found; tools/check-native-inventory.sh compares this list against a staging
# directory that workflow really produced, and against the independent class
# runtime-closure.sh gave each library. A name here that staging does not
# create, a staged file that is not here, and a file claimed twice are three
# different failures and each has its own message.
# Two columns, tab separated: the owning component's key, and the path
# relative to the root of the staged layout. Sorted in the C locale.
# The owner key is deliberately unversioned. What version of Open CASCADE this
# is belongs to tools/occt/pin.env, and repeating it per file would make a
# patch bump edit every line of a file that measures something else.
